chapter: Learning the trade in Los Angeles
title: Barber shop job in Boyle Heights and playing weekends
summary: He worked at a barber shop and lived in Boyle Heights while sitting in on Saturday nights, which led to his buddy Duke Ellighew and a taxi dance job.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Right. Now who do you work with first when you get out to California?
In California?
Yes. What do you do this time?
Well, I first started working at a barber's shop again. Still I did have my horn though
*As far as I know James Porter was never called "King" Porter. --Clayton.
that's one thing. And I had my horn under the bed where I lived in Boyle Heights up in Los Angeles.
(where?)?
Boyle Heights.
How do you spell Boyle
BOYLE. Boyle Heights. That's a district. And I lived with some people and I paid them about three dollars a week. And I remember, I got thirty some dollars behind at the rate of three dollars a week.
This is still while you were in the barber shop?
Yes.
What sort of work were you doing in there?
Oh, just anything. Clean up the barber shop. And open it and close it.
Oh you didn't, you weren't allowed to cut hair
No. (LAUGHTER). No, I never did. I didn't do that. So I stayed at the barber's shop, but at the same time I would take my horn down on Saturday nights where little guys were playing and

I'd play with them. And word finally got around that I could play. I know there was a little guy, another trumpet player, the same age as me, but he had a little band. His name was Duke, everybody's name was Duke in those days, Duke (Ellihue?).
How do you spell that?
ELLI, I believe, HUE.
H?
HUE. Ellihue, Ellihue.
Oh, not GEW?
I think maybe......
I believe that's how you spell Ellihue. You can spell it ELLIGHEW.
Well that could be it, yes, I think so.
May as well state it for the record.

Yes, I think that's right. ELLIGHEW. Anyway, he was a trumpet player. He was trying to learn to play trumpet and he and I became pretty good buddies. And finally, somebody asked me to go to work in this taki dance...
